'''2007 Worlds Team Turd Ferguson LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Turd Ferguson]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Deck title T-money fizzle. Line 58 Scotch MAN Greg → Sense (joke OCR); Sai'torr OCR.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Turd Ferguson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
